title: 중2능률 L06 X-10 대화 빈칸 완성

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 말을 써서 대화 전체를 완성하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오.
(교과서 Listen and Talk / Real-Life Communication)
answers:
G: Look, here are pictures of two interesting places in the US.
B: They look nice. If you go to the US, which of these places would you like to visit?
G: I'd like to visit this place to see the famous statue and take pictures of the city.
B: That sounds fun!
G: I agree! I hope I can go there one day.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 말을 써서 대화 전체를 완성하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오.
(교과서 Listen and Talk / Real-Life Communication)
answers:
G: Dad, let's plan our trip to Australia!
M: Okay, Yumi. Where would you like to go?
G: I'd like to visit the Sydney Opera House.
M: Then how about taking a tour of the Sydney Opera House on the first day? We can learn about the history of the building.
G: That sounds perfect! I'd like to watch a live performance, too.
M: Of course! We can buy tickets to an opera or a classical music concert.
G: I want to see an opera.
M: Okay. I'll look for tickets to an opera.
G: Thank you, Dad. I hope we have a great time.
questions.explainKo: 정답: G: Dad, let's plan our trip to Australia!

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 말을 써서 대화 전체를 완성하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오.
(교과서 Listen and Talk / Real-Life Communication)
answers:
W: We're finally here, the lantern festival in Thailand!
B: There are already a lot of people here.
W: Yes. I'm excited to see the bright lanterns in the sky.
B: Me too! But why do people fly lanterns?
W: People send away bad luck with the lanterns and make wishes.
B: That's interesting!
W: Yes. I bought a lantern for us, too. Let's make a wish!
B: Okay. I'd like to wish for our family's happiness.
W: That's a wonderful wish. Are you ready to fly our lantern? 3, 2, 1, go!
B: Wow, it's beautiful. I really hope our wish comes true.
questions.explainKo: 정답: W: We're finally here, the lantern festival in Thailand!
